statement.ru: Ацтеки ездили верхом задолго до прихода испанцев.
statement.en: The Aztecs rode horses long before the Spanish arrived.

why: Horses died out in the Americas about 10,000 years ago; the Spanish brought them back.

statement.ru: Первая известная в истории забастовка случилась в Древнем Египте.
statement.en: The first known strike in history happened in ancient Egypt.

why: Tomb builders at Deir el-Medina struck over late rations under Ramesses III, the first documented strike.

statement.ru: Колесо изобрели позже, чем построили первые египетские пирамиды.
statement.en: The wheel was invented after the first Egyptian pyramids were built.

why: Wheels appear by about 3500 BC; the first pyramid (Djoser) dates to about 2670 BC.

statement.ru: Столица ацтеков стояла на острове посреди озера.
statement.en: The Aztec capital stood on an island in the middle of a lake.

why: Tenochtitlan was built on an island in Lake Texcoco, where Mexico City is now.

statement.ru: Египетских мумий заворачивали в листы папируса.
statement.en: Egyptian mummies were wrapped in sheets of papyrus.

why: Mummies were wrapped in linen bandages.

statement.ru: Александрийская библиотека сгорела дотла за одну ночь.
statement.en: The Library of Alexandria burned to the ground in a single night.

why: It declined gradually over several centuries; Caesar's fire did not end it.

statement.ru: В Древнем Риме жилые дома строили высотой до девяти этажей.
statement.en: In ancient Rome, blocks of flats were built up to nine storeys high.

why: Insulae could reach nine storeys before Augustus capped them at about 20.7 m.

statement.ru: Сократ записал своё учение в нескольких книгах.
statement.en: Socrates wrote down his teaching in several books.

why: Socrates wrote nothing; we know him through Plato and Xenophon.

statement.ru: Крестоносцы однажды захватили и разграбили христианский Константинополь.
statement.en: Crusaders once captured and sacked Christian Constantinople.

why: The Fourth Crusade sacked the Byzantine capital in April 1204.

statement.ru: На полях средневековых рукописей рисовали рыцарей, бьющихся с улитками.
statement.en: Medieval manuscripts have knights fighting snails drawn in their margins.

why: Knight-versus-snail scenes are a well-known motif of medieval marginalia.

statement.ru: Пирамиды ацтеков и майя заканчивались острой вершиной, как египетские.
statement.en: Aztec and Maya pyramids ended in a sharp point, like Egyptian ones.

why: Mesoamerican pyramids have flat tops, many with temples on them.

statement.ru: Восточная Римская империя пережила Западную почти на тысячу лет.
statement.en: The Eastern Roman Empire outlived the Western one by almost a thousand years.

why: The West fell in 476; the Byzantine (Eastern Roman) Empire lasted until 1453.

statement.ru: Великую хартию вольностей подписал Ричард Львиное Сердце.
statement.en: Magna Carta was sealed by Richard the Lionheart.

why: It was King John, Richard's brother, in 1215.

statement.ru: Ганнибал был римским полководцем.
statement.en: Hannibal was a Roman general.

why: Hannibal was a Carthaginian general, Rome's great enemy.

statement.ru: Месяц август назван в честь императора Нерона.
statement.en: The month of August is named after the emperor Nero.

why: It was renamed in 8 BC for Augustus.

statement.ru: Император Карл Великий начал учиться писать уже взрослым.
statement.en: The emperor Charlemagne only began learning to write as an adult.

why: His biographer Einhard records he only attempted to learn to write later in life.

statement.ru: Оратор Демосфен тренировал речь, набрав в рот камешки.
statement.en: The orator Demosthenes trained his speech with pebbles in his mouth.

why: Plutarch says he overcame a stammer by speaking with pebbles in his mouth.

statement.ru: Майя играли в мяч, отбивая его бёдрами.
statement.en: The Maya played a ball game, hitting the ball with their hips.

why: In the most common form of the Mesoamerican ballgame players struck the rubber ball with their hips.

statement.ru: Жест «V» придумали английские лучники, дразня французов уцелевшими пальцами.
statement.en: The V sign was invented by English archers taunting the French with their unharmed fingers.

why: The Agincourt archer story is a popular legend with no evidence behind it.

statement.ru: Вильгельм Завоеватель, покоривший Англию, сам был англичанином.
statement.en: William the Conqueror, who conquered England, was English himself.

why: He was the Duke of Normandy, a Norman from France.

statement.ru: Мусульмане правили частью Испании больше 700 лет.
statement.en: Muslims ruled part of Spain for more than 700 years.

why: Al-Andalus lasted from 711 to 1492, about 780 years.

statement.ru: Майя жили в Южной Америке.
statement.en: The Maya lived in South America.

why: The Maya live in Mexico and Central America (Guatemala, Belize, Honduras); the Incas were in South America.

statement.ru: Последователи Пифагора отказывались есть бобы.
statement.en: Pythagoras's followers refused to eat beans.

why: Pythagoreans famously refused to eat beans; even ancient writers argued about why.

statement.ru: Тутанхамон умер глубоким стариком.
statement.en: Tutankhamun died a very old man.

why: He died at about 18.

statement.ru: Знатных викингов хоронили прямо в кораблях.
statement.en: Noble Vikings were buried in ships.

why: Viking ship burials, such as Oseberg and Gokstad, laid the dead in whole ships.

statement.ru: Викинги ходили в бой в стальных латах.
statement.en: Vikings went into battle in steel plate armour.

why: At most the rich had mail; poorer warriors wore thick wool. Plate armour came centuries later.

statement.ru: Терракотовые воины изначально были ярко раскрашены.
statement.en: The Terracotta Warriors were originally brightly painted.

why: The figures were painted; the lacquered paint flakes off within minutes of excavation.

statement.ru: У шумеров была отдельная богиня пива.
statement.en: The Sumerians had a goddess of beer.

why: Ninkasi was the Mesopotamian goddess of beer; a hymn to her doubles as a recipe.

statement.ru: Будда родился в Китае.
statement.en: The Buddha was born in China.

why: Tradition places his birth at Lumbini, in today's Nepal.

statement.ru: В Древнем Риме гладиаторами были только мужчины.
statement.en: In ancient Rome only men were gladiators.

why: Female gladiators existed, though rare: e.g. the relief of Amazonia and Achillea.

statement.ru: Знаменитый гобелен из Байё на самом деле вышивка.
statement.en: The famous Bayeux Tapestry is actually an embroidery.

why: It is an embroidered linen cloth, not a woven tapestry.

statement.ru: Шахматы придумали в средневековой Европе.
statement.en: Chess was invented in medieval Europe.

why: Chess descends from chaturanga, an ancient Indian game.

statement.ru: В средневековой Европе свинью могли отдать под суд за убийство.
statement.en: In medieval Europe a pig could be put on trial for murder.

why: Animal trials were held in medieval Europe; pigs were tried for killing children, e.g. 1457.

statement.ru: Колизей построили для гонок на колесницах.
statement.en: The Colosseum was built for chariot racing.

why: It hosted gladiators, beast hunts and shows; chariot races were held in the Circus Maximus.

statement.ru: Баснописец Эзоп, по преданию, был рабом.
statement.en: Tradition says Aesop, the teller of fables, was a slave.

why: The traditional life of Aesop makes him a slave who won his freedom by his wit.

statement.ru: Знатные майя украшали зубы вставками из нефрита.
statement.en: Maya nobles decorated their teeth with jade inlays.

why: Maya nobility practised dental modification; some lords wore jade set into their teeth.

statement.ru: Цифры, которые мы зовём арабскими, придумали в Индии.
statement.en: The digits we call Arabic numerals were invented in India.

why: The system was devised in India and passed to Europe through the Arabs.

statement.ru: Шумерские зиккураты были гробницами царей, как пирамиды.
statement.en: Sumerian ziggurats were royal tombs, like the pyramids.

why: Ziggurats were temple platforms, with a shrine on top, not tombs.
